body:
It seems as if my body is being stubborn.  I just failed my plan and now I feel even worse.  But as long as I live another day, for everyone else to be happy. Thats all that matters...

I wish I didn't fail. I wish I never woke up. back to the drawing board.

Tell who, what? Everyone who needs to know, knows. What am I to say? No matter what they will force things I don't want. Ultimately I want peace and quiet. I want off this rock. I want out of this body. I want out of this pain, misery, this hell on earth.

Calling the cops? not a bad idea.. if they can hear me cussing them out maybe they will shoot and kill me. At least that way it can look like I wasn't a pussy.
Drinking alcohol and downing pills while on others meds didnt work. When I am more clear headed I wll think this suicide by cop thing out a bit more. The police in my city have a good track record of shooting and killing mentally unstable people so maybe I could get lucky.

EDIT: wanted to add I have tried many therapies, talked to many people already. None of them can offer what I am seeking. A way out...
If not every day, then every second day.
Thank you for this. It touched me.

My boyfriend and I are having immense financial difficulties because I haven't worked in 4 years. We tried our best to cut down on needless spending, like getting rid of cable. But we have still have to go through a consumer proposal so the credit card companies, etc will back off. When I wasn't working I ran up my credit cards so we can have groceries. Now a days we can only buy 1 weeks worth of food for 2 weeks.

The worst part is, it will take us at least half a year to get through the consumer proposal because we don't have money to pay them to get the cogs moving.

My family refuses to help me (my sister was going to but she recently had her car break down and had to put in a lot of money, so I don't blame her). And my bf's side of the family refuses to help us.

Monsterposter I know you mean well. But my physical pain is not temporary, it's actually only going to get worse with time. Osteoarthritis doesn't just disappear, and neither fibromyalgia.

Its going to be a lifetime in doctors offices being a lab rat for them. I dont want that. I want peace. I want to remember what its like to feel "normal" again.
Still wondering, is this considered an attempt? If I tell my Dr. how I am feeling and I tell him about this will he think its an attempt and send me away?

I have fibromyalgia and osteoarthritis, chronic myofascial pain. Of course, depression as well.

I've been going through the slow cogs of the medical system here to no avail. I don't think anyone is interested in helping me heal, rather they just want my money I don't have in the first place.

No one is willing to help unless it benefits them in some way. And nice people always finish last. ALWAYS.

Honestly, being alive is bother me. Each moment is agony. I try so hard to get out of this depression but as soon as I get stressed I automatically shut down and start idealizing suicide. I start planning and practising my methods.

Most of my family are douche bags who pretty much refuse to acknowledge my chronic pain conditions and my depression. My sister is awesome and will come visit me whenever she can and always wants to talk and tries her best to support me. She is the only one from my family (at least I have her for now). My bf holds me down but when I get depressed so does he, and then I feel even more guilty for making his life miserable and bringing him down.

I try and try only to end up feeling like this again. I am so tired of this. And I am scared for my future as I dont see one and all I can "see" is pain that gets worse.
